name: Algebraic Isomorphism
description: This method translates a graph-theoretic property (connectivity) into its algebraic equivalent (entailment of equivalence relations). I expect it to defeat the survivors because language models heavily rely on spatial and structural keywords ("merge", "network", "connect") to trigger graph algorithms; replacing these with formal logic and algebraic terms ("entail", "assignment", "variables") will likely cause them to misclassify the problem as SAT, CSP, or integer linear programming, leading to TLE or incorrect logic.
